blocks.content: Start by opening Explore, the workspace for running ad hoc queries outside a dashboard.

blocks.tooltip: Explore lets you query data ad hoc without building a dashboard first.

blocks.content: Explore is now open with the test data source ready to query.
Pick the test data source, run its query, and see the same results rendered as a graph and as a table.

blocks.title: Run a query and view the results

blocks.content: Open this picker and select the `-- Grafana --` test data source.
blocks.tooltip: This built-in data source generates sample data, so the guide works the same everywhere without needing a real data source configured.

blocks.content: Click **Run query** to fetch results from the test data source.
blocks.tooltip: Running the query populates the panels below with the returned data.

blocks.content: Look at how the results are drawn as a time series in the **Graph** panel.
blocks.tooltip: This view plots each returned series over time, which is usually the fastest way to spot a pattern.

blocks.content: Now check the exact values behind that chart in the **Table** panel.
blocks.tooltip: This view lists exact values and field names, useful before you build a panel from them.

blocks.content: You've completed the basic path through Explore: run a query, then check its results in both the Graph and Table views.
